_comment: KehilaConnect — Phase 1 config template. Copy values into your config.json or paste into System Console.

TeamSettings.CustomBrandText: The private communication platform for our kehila.
TeamSettings._note_RestrictCreationToDomains: Set to your community domain(s) e.g. 'bnaiisrael.org,kehilaconnect.com' to limit signups.

ThemeSettings._note_AllowedThemes: Sapphire = Israeli flag blue (closest built-in to KehilaConnect brand). Quartz = light theme. Remove Denim/Indigo/Onyx to keep brand consistent.

LogSettings._note_EnableDiagnostics: Disable telemetry to Mattermost Inc. — required for the Frum Privacy Pledge.

EmailSettings._note_PushNotificationServer: Point to your own push proxy once mobile app is rebranded (Phase 6). Until then, Mattermost HPNS works but shows 'Mattermost' in iOS notification tray.

CustomTermsOfServiceSettings._note: Enable custom Terms of Service. Create the ToS text via System Console → Compliance → Custom Terms of Service after first login.

_setup_checklist: 1. Upload your KehilaConnect logo via System Console → Site → Customization → Custom Brand Image
2. Set SiteURL to your actual domain
3. Configure SMTP settings under EmailSettings for outbound email
4. Install both plugin .tar.gz bundles via System Console → Plugin Management → Upload Plugin
5. Set com.kehilaconnect.tzniut-filter.moderator_channel_id to your moderator channel's ID
6. Create Custom Terms of Service text via System Console → Compliance
7. Restrict signups via TeamSettings.RestrictCreationToDomains if desired
8. Configure LDAP under LdapSettings if integrating with existing directory (Enterprise feature)
